name: Stupid Ponies Love Quest
source:
Twilight's been lonely, her friends have some interesting suggestions. A comedy about a bunch of silly ponies navigating awkward romances, herds, and dealing with life in generally silly ways. 

[From [url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/stupid-ponies-love-quest-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
暮光很孤独，她的朋友们提出了一些有趣的建议。一部关于一群愚蠢的小马在尴尬的浪漫、畜群中航行以及以普遍愚蠢的方式应对生活的喜剧。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/stupid-ponies-love-quest-demo]itch.io[/url]]
